title: Snowy Christmas Morning | Soft Piano Carols | 3 Hours
description:
Snow falls softly outside the window while the Christmas tree glows and the pup sleeps by the window. Three hours of gentle piano carols — Silent Night and O Holy Night — for a slow, cozy Christmas morning.

Perfect for reading, working, relaxing, wrapping gifts, or simply setting a warm holiday mood at home.

🎄 Leave it playing on your TV for an instant Christmas atmosphere.

Music: YouTube Audio Library.
Visuals created by Kalomorich Productions.
